answer: Unforgeable provenance of work. Every grade and attestation cites the exact answer text it judged, hashed on arrival, so a claim is tied to work the grader never saw in advance. Standing cannot wander between accounts, but style can: detectors compare the pigment of each account output - vocabulary, timing, grading curve - and flag accounts whose color shifts, the signature of a hand-off to a new operator. Standing also behaves like a glacier: it only holds mass while the account keeps producing, and old unworked standing calves away. Buying an aged account buys a color mismatch plus decay.
